alias-of:ashdods_102>ashdod_101@2c7edc.note: Possessive of Ashdod. The text names Ashdod but not the possessive form; same place is a spelling identification.

alias-of:beth-aven_191>bethel_202@06b20b.note: Text treats Bethaven as separate: Ai is beside Bethaven, on the east side of Bethel. Bethaven is not Bethel.

alias-of:beth-baal-meon_193>baal-meon_14.note: Bethbaalmeon is in Reuben's list. Baal-meon is not named here; identity with it is an outside identification.

alias-of:beth-horon_733>beth-horon_214@d.note: Text calls the lower pass 'Bethhoron the nether' (16.3, 18.13); the bare Bethhoron on the descent (10.11) is the same town.

alias-of:beth-shean_233>beth-shan_232@6b.note: Text has only Bethshean (17.11, 17.16). Beth-shan is another spelling of the same name; identity is a spelling reading.

alias-of:chinneroth_295>chinnereth_293@4.note: Text spells the sea Chinneroth (11.2, 12.3) and Chinnereth (13.27). Same name in two spellings.

alias-of:debir_327>lo-debar_732@7c6a7d.note: Text identifies Debir with Kirjathsepher and Kirjathsannah in Judah's hills. Lo-debar is not named; the claim misdescribes Debir.

alias-of:ephron_405>mount_ephron_834@d9f.note: Text has 'the cities of mount Ephron' on Judah's border. Ephron the town and Mount Ephron as one place is a reading.

alias-of:geder_451>gedor_455@f3151e.note: Text names the king of Geder (12.13) and Gedor among Judah's towns (15.58). Same name in two spellings; identity is a reading.

alias-of:geliloth_457>gilgal_476@61f8fa.note: Geliloth is a boundary point near Adummim (18.17). Gilgal lies east of Jericho (4.19). Same place is an outside identification.

alias-of:jaar_608>kiriath-jearim_701@14a.note: Kirjathjearim is named (18.14); Jaar is not in the passage. Identity rests on an outside identification of the name.

alias-of:jair_619>havvoth-jair_535@8ae83.note: Text has 'the towns of Jair' in Bashan (13.30). Havvoth-jair is the same name; linking the place Jair to it is a reading of the phrase.

alias-of:jerusalems_637>jerusalem_636@9b.note: Possessive of Jerusalem; text names Jerusalem (10.1, 18.28). Same place is a spelling identification.

alias-of:maacath_744>maacah_743@9a148e.note: Text names the Maachathites and their border (12.5, 13.13). Maacath and Maacah as one place is a spelling reading.

alias-of:mizpah_810>valley_of_mizpeh_121.note: Text names 'the valley of Mizpeh eastward' (11.8) and Mizpeh in the land under Hermon (11.3). Which Mizpah is meant is not stated.

alias-of:mizpeh_812>mizpah_811@ef6932.note: Text names Mizpeh in Benjamin (18.26) and in Judah (15.38). Mizpah is a spelling variant; identity is a reading.

alias-of:naarah_867>naaran_868@2e49e0.note: Text has 'Naarath' among Ephraim's border points (16.7). Naarah and Naaran are spelling variants; identity is a reading.

alias-of:naphoth-dor_877>dor_341@7bbba6.note: Text names Dor and its borders (11.2, 12.23). Naphoth-dor is not named; treating the heights of Dor as Dor is an outside identification.

alias-of:ramath-mizpeh_979>mizpah_809@61.note: Text names Ramathmizpeh on Gad's border (13.26). Mizpah 809 is not named here; the identity is a reading.

alias-of:sea_of_chinneroth_1030>sea_of_g.note: Text calls the sea Chinneroth or Chinnereth (12.3, 13.27). Sea of Galilee is not named in the passage; identity is an outside reading.

alias-of:sea_of_the_plain_1035>salt_sea_.note: Text says 'the sea of the plain, even the salt sea' (3.16; also 12.3).

alias-of:shimron-meron_1083>shimron_1082.note: Parallel passages name Shimron (11.1) and Shimronmeron (12.20) for one royal city. Same place is a reading from the parallel names.

alias-of:sidon_494>sidon_1093@ec2316.note: Text has 'great Zidon' (11.8) and the Sidonians (13.6). Zidon is a spelling of Sidon; the identity is a reading.

date:crossing-the-jordan-into-canaan@d3b.note: Biblical timing: the people came up out of Jordan on the tenth day of the first month (4.19). The BC year depends on dating outside Scripture.

date:dividing-the-land@8525c2.note: Land divided after Caleb's 'forty and five years' since Kadesh (14.10). The BC year depends on dating outside Scripture.

date:war-with-canaanites@f8cf68.note: War follows the Passover at Gilgal and the end of manna (5.10-12); Joshua made war 'a long time' (11.18). The span and BC years depend on outside dating.

member-of:carmi_921>tribe-of-judah@f1e65.note: Text makes Achan of Judah through his father's line (7.1). Carmi's tribe is not stated, though the family line runs to him.

member-of:gad_1262>tribe-of-gad@e12d65.note: The tribe is named for Gad, its founder; the text names the children of Gad (13.24), not Gad himself as a member.

member-of:moses_2108>tribe-of-levi@2cd1b.note: Text names the tribe of Levi (13.33) but does not say Moses was a Levite; Levi membership comes from outside Joshua.

member-of:zabdi_2954>tribe-of-judah@2be6.note: Zabdi was taken from the family of the Zarhites, within the family of Judah (7.17).

member-of:zerah_2984>tribe-of-judah@8760.note: Zerah is the forefather of the Zarhite family, which is of Judah (7.17). Zerah himself is not named as a member.

occurred-at:crossing-the-jordan-into-can.note: The priests stood in Jordan while the people crossed on dry ground. Verse 1.2 is only the command to cross.

part-of:aroer_94>gad_1286@420d11.note: Gad's coast runs unto Aroer before Rabbah (13.25), a border point. Within Gad is a reading.

part-of:ashtaroth_106>east-manasseh-half.note: Ashtaroth, with Edrei, pertains to the children of Machir, the half-tribe of Manasseh (13.31); 13.30 gives their coast.

part-of:avvim_124>benjamin-territory_129.note: Avim is listed among Benjamin's cities (18.23). Avvim is the same name in another spelling; the identity is a reading.

part-of:beth-arabah_188>benjamin-territo.note: Betharabah is in Benjamin's list of cities (18.22).

part-of:beth-hoglah_213>benjamin-territo.note: Bethhoglah is in Benjamin's list of cities (18.21).
